name: fast-jev-compaction
description: Verbatim Jev-guided compaction for Claude Code sessions.

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: TypeSafe API key. Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability that a tool call or tool result is still needed; below it the item is removed.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction.

minReductionPercent.title: Minimum reduction (percent)
minReductionPercent.description: Below this reduction the pruning is not applied at all: the next request would rewrite the retained prefix into the prompt cache for almost no saving. Measured 2026-09-22 over 22 real compactions: 40% or more paid the rewrite back within 5-16 responses, below it 24-1214.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio (retired)
minReductionRatio.description: Retired name of minReductionPercent, as a 0..1 ratio. Kept so an existing settings.json keeps working; minReductionPercent wins when both are set.

maxRetainedTokens.title: Maximum retained tokens
maxRetainedTokens.description: Ceiling on the estimated tokens the compacted history may keep. Calls Jev decided to keep are escalated oldest-first (result dropped, then the call) until the history fits, so the retained size cannot ratchet upwards across successive compactions. 0 turns the budget off.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum Jev state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the conversation state sent with every Jev request.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum Jev request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated token budget for state plus questions in one Jev request.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result kept when Jev decides its full output is no longer needed; 0 keeps only the note.

coldCompaction.title: Compact when the prompt cache will miss
coldCompaction.description: Before a model call that will miss the prompt cache anyway (new machine, another profile, another model, or a gap longer than cacheTtlMinutes), run one Jev compaction; skip silently when there is too little to remove.

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Prompt cache TTL (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: How long the prompt cache survives without use: 5 by default, 60 on accounts with the 1-hour cache.

fallbackAtPercent.title: Fallback fill
fallbackAtPercent.description: A threshold compaction that removes too little falls back to the built-in summary only at or above this context percentage; below it, nothing happens.

stateDir.title: State directory
stateDir.description: Where the per-session cache state files live. Empty = $HOME/.cache/fast-jev-compaction.

minColdTokens.title: Minimum history for a cold compaction
minColdTokens.description: Below this many estimated history tokens a cache-cold compaction is not worth a Jev request.

apiKeyFile.title: TypeSafe API key file
apiKeyFile.description: Path of a file holding the TypeSafe API key (e.g. a mounted Kubernetes secret). Takes precedence over TYPESAFE_API_KEY.
